details.description: The Just Organik Raw and Unrefined Sugar brings you a natural sweetener that provides a quick boost of energy and helps increase blood sugar levels. Sugar is naturally white. White table sugar comes from either sugarcane or sugar beets and is usually sold without its plant source clearly identified. Refined table sugar is pure, crystallised sucrose, much in the same way that pure salt is simply sodium chloride. Add white sugar to your home-made cakes, biscuits and chocolates. White sugar is sweeter than brown sugar, so you can use less of it to attain your desired taste. Its neutral flavour makes it a versatile ingredient in baking, working well in fruit sponges and sweet pastries. Explore Just Organik's natural products ranging from Cereals, Pulses, Flour, Jaggery and more, only on Big Basket.
